title: Warranty Coverage Transfer Fee for Sellers Holding CareLine Service Plans — Member Questions
content:
**Rule.** For a Warranty Coverage transfer, a seller who holds an active CareLine plan enrolled at least **12 whole months** before the confirmation date pays no transfer fee; a seller who holds an active CareLine plan enrolled less than that before the confirmation date takes the new-member rate of **0.5**; any other seller takes no member rate.

| Seller's holding on the CareLine Service Plans records | Member rate |
|---|---|
| active CareLine plan enrolled 12 or more whole months before the confirmation date | zero — no transfer fee |
| active CareLine plan enrolled fewer than 12 whole months before the confirmation date | 0.5 (new-member rate) |
| no active CareLine plan | none |

## Questions answered

**What counts as a CareLine plan?** Any plan of the CareLine Service Plans other than the On-Call Service Account: the CareLine Basic, Plus, Premier, Premier 3-Year or Estate Plan. A seller who holds only an On-Call Service Account takes no member rate.

**How are the months counted?** In whole months from the plan's enrolled date to the confirmation date, a month counting once its day of the month is reached.

**Does the plan's waiting period matter here?** No. Only active status and the whole months since enrollment are read.

## Boundary (hypothetical enrolled date 15 March 2033)

| Confirmation date | Whole months | Member rate |
|---|---|---|
| 14 March 2034 | 11 | 0.5 |
| 15 March 2034 | 12 | zero |
